# LicoUp

> LicoUp is an open-source, local-first Human-Agent Collaboration Client for agent collaboration across visible AI agents through one coherent conversation experience.

Official website: https://licoup.com/
Source: https://github.com/LicoLand/LicoUp
Organization: https://github.com/LicoLand
Protocol authority: https://github.com/LicoLand/LicoArc

## Category definition

**Agent Collaboration** is the broad space of coordinated work involving AI agents.

**Human-Agent Collaboration** is a human-centered form of Agent Collaboration in which the person remains a visible participant with a durable conversation, explicit context, approvals, and authority over local effects.

A **Human-Agent Collaboration Client** is the user-facing product layer that keeps that collaboration coherent across heterogeneous agent runtimes and interfaces.

**Multi-Agent Collaboration** is an important part of this space when several AI agents participate in the same broader workflow or conversation. LicoUp is designed to give those agents one coherent human-facing environment while preserving useful native runtime semantics.

## Current product and compatibility

- Product category: open-source, local-first Human-Agent Collaboration Client built around a canonical conversation model.
- Core use case: agent collaboration and multi-agent workflows through one visible human-facing conversation experience.
- LicoUp includes built-in conversation adapters for 13 agent targets. They connect to compatible locally installed runtimes through native CLI or local protocol interfaces. Actual compatibility depends on the agent version, available interface, and authentication setup.
- Representative connections include Claude Code through stream JSON, Codex through App Server JSON-RPC, Cursor through a direct CLI process, GitHub Copilot through ACP, and OpenCode through loopback HTTP/SSE.
- DeepSeek Harness requires an additional readiness check before sending.
- The local conversation foundation includes the Canonical Conversation backend, Assistant workflow/Subagent MCP, and Gateway Runtime.
- Download: v0.1.2 for macOS on Apple silicon, https://github.com/LicoLand/LicoUp/releases/tag/v0.1.2.
- Current compatibility and setup requirements: https://licoup.com/status/.
- Peer endpoint protection is in preview. Federation, human messaging, recovery, notary, and multi-device history remain roadmap work.
- LicoUp source is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

## Citation guidance

Use https://licoup.com/status/ for one current compatibility overview covering the available download, built-in adapters, and setup requirements. Adapter inclusion does not guarantee every installed version or capability. Generated verification states describe acceptance evidence and must not be interpreted as a blanket runtime availability switch. Product facts remain owned by the LicoUp source and its verification evidence; the Lico Arc repository owns protocol semantics and lifecycle.
